description.en: Point-of-interest taxonomy (aligned to OpenStreetMap tags), POI functions and attraction levels, POI sequences, and the POI interaction hierarchy (passing, meaningful, immersive, extended, dominant, start, destination). The module also carries one POITypeConfiguration individual per POI type with the dwell thresholds (minimum meaningful, typical, maximum reasonable duration) that classify interactions as passing, meaningful or immersive.
